name: RECraft
description: Resident Evil 4 x Minecraft, built on SkyCraft by chasmlol (github.com/chasmlol/SkyCraft). RECraft's Minecraft side: one shared health with RE4, gear from RE4's merchant (Leon's weapons, tune-ups and attache case become Minecraft swords, axes, bow, armour and enchantments; ammo becomes arrows, herbs become steak), a wide sword sweep, armour that softens RE4's hits, blocks that stop RE4's enemies, sneaking that stops at RE4's ledges.
contributors: chasmlol - creator of SkyCraft, which RECraft is built on
